Stay tuned! rOc-nOc.com offers Mikrotik Routerboards, RouterOS, APs, and other high value networking products with live inventory for your ISP, WISP, or other networking application. rOc-nOc.com is the on-line network supplier with a difference. We know what we sell, we support what we sell, and we maintain inventory to fill our customer needs. We employ certified network professionals and offer low-cost, high-value products to help make your business more competitive and reliable. Shop our site for Mikrotik routers, switches, WiFi APs, radios, wired and wireless LAN and WAN products. Our staff has over 20 years of experience in serving the wired and wireless networking markets and using the same products that we sell in our ISP. Support, configuration, and network engineering services are available for every product that we sell. Our live on-line inventory is accurate and updated in real time. Volume discounts are available on many products sold in case lots of 20 and 100 pieces. Call for quantity pricing or click on an item to see quantity pricing online. We serve North American and Export markets with shipments daily using FedEx, Spee-Dee Delivery, and USPS. We offer same day shipping by FedEx on most domestic orders placed by 5pm Central Time. Spee-Dee Delivery and USPS orders should be placed by 3pm for same day shipping. Most US Ground shipments will be sent by FedEx Ground or Spee-Dee Delivery service. Select the domestic shipping tab to see the time-in-transit and coverage maps . We reserve the right to adjust incorrect shipping amounts and we will select the best shipper unless you send us a message in the comments field of your order with your preferred shipper. subpages.text: Home :: Power Supplies / PoE :: 18POW-US Mikrotik 24vdc, 19 watt universal switching power supply wirth 2.1mm DC plug and Type A USA plug Printable version 18POW-US Mikrotik 24vdc, 19 watt universal switching power supply wirth 2.1mm DC plug and Type A USA plug Mikrotik 18POW-US 24 vdc, 19 watt (.8 amp) universal switching power supply with 2.1mm DC plug. Narrow housing and right angle plug only uses a single space in a conventional power tap. Type A USA AC input plug operates from 100 to 240 vac. UL approved for use in the USA. Supports all Routerboards. Use with RB/P54 POE injector for POE support on all routerboards except RB200 and RB600 which should use 48vdc for POE. NOTE: The current 18POW supply is 24vdc 19.2 watts (.8amp) and the old 18POW was 18vdc 18 watts. Both supplies will work with all current model RouterBoards except the RB1000. The 24volt supply will not work with the RB532 boards.
